{{Top|leg}}
'''Dannax''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Personnel Division of the Army of the Galactic Republic|Department of Personnel Action]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]]. After the events of the [[Barrager]] mission on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cassius Madine]] submitted a [[Transfer Request Form 4187]] that was processed by Lieutenant Dannax.
